examine: Has a small label: 'Property of B.B.'
There's a peephole. Wait, no. Just a knot in the wood. Probably.
Seems to shift slightly when not observed.
open: It's locked from the inside. Wait, that can't be right.
A voice whispers: 'Not yet...' Probably the wind.
rumor: Some say it walks at night.
Barrelman Bob won't sell this one. 'Special inventory,' he says.
A barrelgob was seen talking to it. Then went inside. Never came out.
The luchadors use it for training. It hits back.
dialog.secret: The barrel knows. The barrel remembers. The barrel... waits.
